build.title: Build progress
build.sub: Every stage and PR of the build, from the master register ({asOf})
build.noDocs: The register is not on the server yet. It is copied there with every deploy.

filter.qPh: PR number or words — e.g. 594, backup, gift

list.title: {n} PRs
list.none: No PR matches. Try other words, or clear the filters.
list.more: Showing the first {shown} of {n}. Narrow the search to see the rest.

pr.title: PR {n} · {title}
pr.notFound: There is no PR {n} in the register.
pr.derived: The register keeps this PR as part of its stage's scope; the blueprint's list of every PR names it.
pr.noNotes: No change note names this PR.

problems.title: Reported problems
problems.sub: Problems reported on a PR of the build, and what happened to each

none.open: No open problem. Report one from a PR's card, or with the button above.
none.done: Nothing is fixed or closed yet.

files.title: Blueprint & files
files.sub: The blueprint, the register and every supporting file, as the last deploy copied them to the server
files.noDocs: The files are not on the server yet. They are copied there with every deploy.
files.searchPh: Search inside every file — e.g. exchange window, CN-020
files.backup: Every backup carries the same files with their commit (Google Drive and Azure Blob). The copies of other people's skills are never listed.

read.notFound: That file is not in the docs copy.
read.found: {n} matches in this file; parts with a match are marked ●
read.versionsSub: The copies the server keeps, one line per change
read.noVersions: Only this version is on the server.

report.btnPr: Report a problem on this PR
report.notePh: What you saw, where, and what you expected
report.page: Where you saw it (an admin address, if you know it)
report.what: It goes to the build team with the PR named. You see its status on Reported problems and on the PR's card.
report.done: Sent. It is R-{n} on the list.

status.note: How it was fixed, or why it is closed

err.UNKNOWN_PR: There is no PR with that number in the register.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields: a PR number, a note of at least 3 letters, and an admin address that starts with /admin.
err.NOTE_NEEDED: Say how it was fixed, or why it is closed.
err.NOT_FOUND: This report is not there any more. Reload the page.
err.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this. Ask the owner.
err.other: That did not work. Try again.
